title: 978 到达977 太远了
content_zh:
978.到达
接下来整整一个月的行程，两人几乎都在传送阵与飞船之间辗转交替，每从天域传送阵中踏出，四周的天地灵气便会骤然一变，或炽烈如熔炉，或清冷如寒潭，或浑厚如大地之息，每一片天域都有其截然不同的气息与风貌。
洛豪虽然无法亲眼得见每一处天域的全貌，但仅仅是透过传送阵间隙那些一闪而过的光影与灵气波动，他便已深刻感受到三十三天之广袤与层次之分明。
而这一路上，他始终谨守着分寸，没有再多问半句不该问的话，也没有再提起那第五颗圆珠的事，整个人显得安静而克制。
这种沉默起初并未引起萧中研的注意，可随着路程渐行渐远，她渐渐察觉到了洛豪话语间那种刻意的收敛与疏离，她心里不由得泛起一丝警觉——这可不是什么好兆头。
她费了这么大周折才把人请来，若是让洛豪带着这种“不满意”的情绪回到金刀仙门，万一在父亲面前露了半分不情愿或冷淡的姿态，那这场冒充大戏便不攻自破了。
她父亲是何等精明的人物，哪怕只是细微的神情不对，都可能被他一眼看穿，而一旦被拆穿，她不仅难以逃脱那桩婚事，还会连累洛豪也跟着吃不了兜着走。
想到这里，萧中研终于开始主动放软姿态，她不再像之前那样冷着脸敷衍洛豪的疑问，反而找着话头，主动与他攀谈起来，她先是漫不经心地问了几句他在灰苇丹楼的日常，又随口聊了聊仙丹炼制中的一些心得与趣闻。
见洛豪偶尔也会搭上几句话，她便顺势将话题越扯越宽，渐渐引向仙界三十三天的风土人情、各天域之间的势力分布、以及各个品阶仙人的实力划分与地位高下。
她出身大极仙门，自小便耳濡目染，见闻之广博远超寻常修士，说起那些奇闻异事来娓娓道来、绘声绘色，连带着那些错综复杂的规矩与禁忌，也能用三言两语讲得通俗易懂。
洛豪自然是巴不得有这样的机会多补一补自己的见识，他原本对三十三天的了解，除了那些名字之外几乎一片空白——以前在修真界时，他连飞升之后的格局都只是囫囵吞枣地听人提过几句，真正到了仙界之后，又一直埋头于炼丹与修行，哪里腾得出时间去打听这些大面上的事？
而此刻萧中研主动送上来这些知识，对他来说无异于一场及时的甘霖，他听得津津有味，时不时还会追问一两个细节，而萧中研也难得耐心地一一作答，两人之间的气氛倒是在这段日子里渐渐回暖了不少。
洛豪心里也明白，萧中研这是怕他带着情绪去见她的父亲，所以刻意在缓和关系。但他也并不反感——毕竟这对他自己而言也是实打实的收获。
正当洛豪在心里盘算着，是否该趁着此刻气氛尚可，找个合适的由头把话题慢慢绕回那颗圆珠的去向之上时，萧中研却仿佛与他心有灵犀一般，主动将这茬提了出来。
她微微侧过头，目光望着舱外流转的云霞，语气中带着几分随意的闲聊意味，
“对了，之前我不是跟你提过那颗被我录下影像的圆珠么？我后来又从我父亲那里听说了一些新的情况——那天拍卖会上买走那颗圆珠的人，其实根本就不是我们下十一天域里的修士。按我父亲的推测，那人应当来自中天域，甚至不排除是上天域某位大能的手笔。而且对方的修为深不可测，我父亲至少认为他是一名仙君，甚至仙皇级别的存在也不是没有可能。”
她说这话时语气颇为平淡，仿佛只是在讲一件与自己无关的旧闻，可洛豪听在耳中，心头却猛地一沉——这消息的真正含义远比表面看起来要复杂得多。
如果买主来自中天域或上天域，那意味着那颗金珠早已不在下天域的势力范围之内，他想要追索的难度又凭空增加了数倍不止，而且更为关键的是，他从萧中研这番话中敏锐地捕捉到了一个细节，她从头到尾都只是在转述她父亲的推测，而没有说出任何关于那位买主的具体信息——姓名、样貌、门派、出手时的特征，一样都没有。
这说明萧中研自己压根就不知道那个人究竟是谁，她之前说“只有我和我父亲几个人知道”，分明就是在虚张声势，用来当作与他讨价还价的筹码罢了。
洛豪心里一阵强烈的失望涌上来，像是一盆冷水兜头浇下，将他之前所有关于“同行途中慢慢套话”的打算都冲得七零八落，他原本以为，只要忍住性子、跟萧中研走完这一趟，至少能从她口中撬出买主的姓名与来历，可如今方知，她拿出来的不过是一个空壳子。

他的语气不由得带上了几分抑制不住的讥讽，几乎是脱口而出，
“原来你也不知道那人是谁啊。我当初听了你那番话，还以为你真掌握着什么了不得的内幕消息呢，闹了半天，也不过是道听途说。”
这话一出口，洛豪便知道自己失言了，他分明早已告诫过自己，绝不能对圆珠表现出任何超出寻常的兴趣，可方才那股失望的情绪一时没能压住，竟让他脱口说出了这般明显带着情绪的话。
萧中研的眉头果然瞬间便竖了起来，眼底腾起一层薄薄的怒意——自己好心好意陪他说了这么多天的话，解了他那么多惑，连圆珠的事也主动拿出来当闲聊的由头给他听，他不感激也就罢了，反倒回过头来冷嘲热讽，这算什么意思？她嘴唇微张，显然正要反唇相讥。
而洛豪在那句话出口的同一瞬间，心中便已警觉起来，他暗骂了自己一声——心性还是不够沉稳，当那种患得患失的情绪涌上心头时，他依旧没能做到完全的收放自如。
他此刻甚至能感觉到自己的心跳比方才快了几分，那是失望与焦虑交织之下难以掩盖的生理反应，他赶忙垂下眼帘，将面上的情绪用力压了回去，暗自深吸一口气，提醒自己，无论如何，关于圆珠的事，一个字都不能再多说了。哪怕心中的失落再浓，也必须在萧中研面前维持住那副“与我无关”的淡然模样。
就在这气氛即将因为他的那句失言而陡然变冷、萧中研的反讽也已蓄势待发的那个刹那，萧中研的面色却忽然一变——那抹怒意像是被一阵风吹散了一般，转而化作惊喜与雀跃，眉眼间瞬间亮起了光彩。
她甚至来不及再说半个字的反击之语，便一把拽住了洛豪的胳膊，将他从座椅上拉了起来，三两步便带着他走到了飞船的船首之处，她迅速地调整了一下站位，将他拉近到自己身侧，甚至刻意让两人的肩膀几乎贴在一起，然后在洛豪耳边压低声音飞快的开口，
978.到达
“站好了，别乱动，表情自然些——我门派的人来接我了。”
content_en:
978.Arrived
During the next entire month of travel, the two of them almost spent their time alternating between the teleportation array and the spaceship. Every time they stepped out of the heavenly realm teleportation array, the aura of the surrounding heaven and earth would suddenly change. It might be as blazing as a furnace, or as cold as a cold pool, or as thick as the breath of the earth. Each piece of heaven has its own completely different atmosphere and style.
Although Luo Hao could not see the whole picture of every heaven with his own eyes, he could already deeply feel the vastness and distinct levels of the thirty-three days just through the flashes of light, shadow and spiritual energy fluctuations in the gaps between the teleportation arrays.
And along the way, he always maintained a sense of propriety. He didn't ask any more questions that he shouldn't have asked, and he didn't mention the fifth ball again. His whole person seemed quiet and restrained.
This silence did not attract Xiao Zhongyan's attention at first, but as the journey got farther and farther, she gradually noticed the deliberate restraint and alienation in Luo Hao's words, and she couldn't help but feel a sense of alarm in her heart - this was not a good sign.
She had gone through so much trouble to invite people here. If Luo Hao returned to the Golden Sword Immortal Sect with such a "dissatisfied" mood, or showed any signs of reluctance or indifference in front of his father, then this fake show would be self-defeating.
What a shrewd person her father was, he could see through even the slightest mistake in his expression. Once exposed, not only would it be difficult for her to escape from the marriage, but Luo Hao would also be left with trouble.
Thinking of this, Xiao Zhongyan finally began to take the initiative to soften his attitude. She no longer responded to Luo Hao's questions with a cold face like before. Instead, she found the topic and took the initiative to chat with him. She first casually asked him a few questions about his daily life in the Gray Reed Pill House, and then casually chatted about some experiences and anecdotes about elixir refining.
Seeing that Luo Hao occasionally exchanged a few words, she took advantage of the situation and broadened the topic, gradually leading to the customs and customs of the thirty-three days of the immortal world, the distribution of forces among the various heavenly realms, and the division of strength and status of the immortals of various levels.
She was born in the Great Immortal Sect, and her ears and eyes have been influenced by it since she was a child. Her knowledge and knowledge are far beyond those of ordinary monks. She can talk about the strange things in a vivid and vivid way, and even the intricate rules and taboos can be explained in a few words in an easy-to-understand manner.
Luo Hao was naturally eager to have such an opportunity to supplement his knowledge. His original understanding of the Thirty-Three Heavens was almost blank except for those names - when he was in the world of cultivation, he only heard a few mentions about the situation after ascension. After he actually arrived in the immortal world, he has been immersed in alchemy and practice. Where can he find time to inquire about these big things?
At this moment, Xiao Zhongyan took the initiative to send this knowledge, which was like a timely rain for him. He listened with great interest, and would ask for one or two details from time to time. Xiao Zhongyan also rarely answered patiently, and the atmosphere between the two gradually warmed up a lot during these days.
Luo Hao also knew in his heart that Xiao Zhongyan was afraid that he would meet her father with emotions, so he deliberately eased the relationship. But he didn't resent it - after all, this was a real gain for himself.
Just as Luo Hao was pondering in his mind whether he should take advantage of the good atmosphere at the moment to find a suitable excuse to slowly bring the topic back to the whereabouts of the ball, Xiao Zhongyan seemed to have a connection with him and took the initiative to bring it up.
She turned her head slightly and looked at the clouds flowing outside the cabin, with a hint of casual chat in her tone.
"By the way, didn't I mention to you the ball on which I recorded the image before? I later heard some new information from my father - the person who bought the ball at the auction that day was actually not a monk from our eleventh lower heaven domain at all. According to my father's speculation, that person should be from the middle heaven domain, and it is not even ruled out that it was the work of a powerful person from the upper heaven domain. AndMoreover, the other party's cultivation level is unfathomable. My father at least thinks that he is an Immortal Lord, or even an Immortal Emperor-level existence is not impossible. "
When she said this, her tone was quite calm, as if she was just telling an old news that had nothing to do with her, but when Luo Hao heard it, his heart suddenly sank - the true meaning of this news was far more complicated than it seemed.
If the buyer comes from the Zhongtian Territory or the Upper Heaven Territory, it means that the golden bead is no longer within the sphere of influence of the Lower Heaven Territory, and the difficulty of his pursuit has increased several times out of thin air. And more importantly, he keenly captured a detail from Xiao Zhongyan's words. She was just relaying her father's speculation from beginning to end, without giving any specific information about the buyer - name, appearance, sect, and characteristics at the time of the move.
This shows that Xiao Zhongyan herself does not know who that person is at all. Her previous statement that "only me and my father know" was clearly a bluff and was used as a bargaining chip with him.
A strong disappointment welled up in Luo Hao's heart, like a bucket of cold water poured down his head, and all his previous plans of "slowly talking to each other during the journey" were dashed to pieces. He originally thought that as long as he held back his temper and finished the trip with Xiao Zhongyan, he could at least pry out the name and origin of the buyer from her mouth, but now he knew that what she brought out was just an empty shell.
His tone couldn't help but contain a bit of uncontrollable sarcasm, and he almost blurted out,
“It turns out you don’t know who that person is. When I first heard what you said, I thought you really had some great inside information. After a long time of fussing, it was just hearsay. "
As soon as these words came out of his mouth, Luo Hao knew that he had made a mistake. He had clearly warned himself that he must not show any extraordinary interest in Yuanzhu, but the disappointment he felt just now could not be suppressed for a moment, and he blurted out such obviously emotional words.
Sure enough, Xiao Zhongyan's brows rose instantly, and a thin layer of anger rose in his eyes - he had kindly talked to him for so many days, solved so many of his confusions, and even took the initiative to bring up the matter of Yuanzhu as an excuse for small talk. It was fine that he was not grateful, but instead turned around and ridiculed him. What does this mean? Her lips were slightly parted, obviously about to retort.
At the same moment when Luo Hao said those words, he was alert in his heart. He cursed himself secretly - his mind was still not calm enough. When the emotion of worrying about gains and losses surged into his heart, he still couldn't fully control it.
At this moment, he could even feel that his heartbeat was a few minutes faster than before. It was a physiological reaction that was difficult to conceal under the mixture of disappointment and anxiety. He quickly lowered his eyes, suppressed the emotions on his face, secretly took a deep breath, and reminded himself that no matter what, he could not say another word about Yuanzhu. No matter how deep the loss in my heart is, I must maintain the indifferent look of "it has nothing to do with me" in front of Xiao Zhongyan.
Just when the atmosphere was about to suddenly turn cold due to his gaffe, and Xiao Zhongyan's irony was ready to strike, Xiao Zhongyan's expression suddenly changed - the anger seemed to be blown away by a gust of wind, and turned into surprise and excitement, and his eyebrows instantly lit up.
She didn't even have time to say half a word of counterattack, so she grabbed Luo Hao's arm, pulled him up from the seat, and took him to the bow of the spacecraft in a few steps. She quickly adjusted her position and pulled him close to her side, even deliberately making their shoulders almost touching, and then spoke quickly in Luo Hao's ear with a low voice,
978.Arrived
"Stand still, don't move around, keep your expression natural - people from my sect are here to pick me up. "
